text.en:
In addition to its present membership, the Central Visayas
Regional Projects Board shall have four (4) members from the private sector
and non-government organizations who shall be appointed by the President
upon nomination by the Regional Development Council for Region VIL. The
following criteria shall be considered in the selection of the nominees;
1. representatives of the private sector and non-government
organizations must be nominated by organizations duly
registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission;
2. the organization should preferably be regional in scope; and,
3.
sectoral representation should be as wide as possible.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 9th day of August, in the year of Our
Lord, nineteen hundred and ninety.
